:::{#thm-affine-linear-iff}
#### An affine map is linear exactly when its offset is zero

An [affine map](#def-affine-map) $f(\vx) = \matr{A}\vx + \vec{b}$
is [linear](#def-linear-map) [if and only if](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/proof-writing.html#def-iff) its [offset](#def-affine-offset) is zero:

$$
f \text{ is linear} \iff \vec{b} = \vzero.
$$ {#eq-affine-linear-iff}

:::

::: proof

If $\vec{b} = \vzero$, then

$$
\begin{aligned}
f(\vx) &= \matr{A}\vx + \vzero \\
&= \matr{A}\vx,
\end{aligned}
$$

which is linear by @thm-matrix-map-linear.
Conversely, if $f$ is linear, then $f(\vzero) = \vzero$ by @thm-linear-map-zero,
and $f(\vzero) = \vec{b}$ by @thm-affine-map-zero,
so $\vec{b} = \vzero$.

:::
